title: Zaniza Zapotec - Wikipedia
text: Zaniza Zapotec (Zapoteco de Santa María Zaniza) is an Oto-Manguean language of western Oaxaca, Mexico. It is one of several Zapotec languages called Papabuco. It has only 10% intelligibility with Texmelucan Zapotec, its closest important relative. text: Zaniza Zapotec is an endangered Oto-Manguean language spoken exclusively in the town of Santa María Zaniza, situated in the Sola de Vega District of Oaxaca state in southern Mexico.
